name: Speaker intro card
definition: Photo, name and role, a few responsibility bullets and a scope note on the opening slide.
bestUse: Talks where the speaker needs to establish credibility first.

demo.how: The card introduces the speaker before the content: a photo, name and role, three bullets on what they are responsible for, and a scope note saying what this talk covers and what it does not. Play builds those parts in order. The person and photo are invented placeholders.
